items.title: Predicting and detecting failures: How Azure strengthens reliability for mission-critical workloads
items.summary: Azure Failure Prediction and Detection (AFPD) helps reduce interruptions by predicting hardware failures, moving eligible workloads, and notifying customers when action is needed. See what that means for SAP on Azure and other mission-critical workloads.The post Predicting and detecting failures: How Azure strengthens reliability for mission-critical workloads appeared first on Microsoft Azure Blog.
items.creator: Mark Russinovich
